source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to electromagnetic radiation (PDF 186-187).

blocks.text: Roshni aur electromagnetic radiation ki doosri shakalein thartharate bijli aur magnetic fields se bani lehron ki shakal mein safar karti hain. Lehrein apni wavelength (lambda) aur frequency (nu) se bayan hoti hain, aur roshni ki raftaar, c = 3.0 x 10^8 m/s, se chalti hain. In ka taalluq c = lambda x nu hai, jahan lambda meters mein, nu hertz (s^-1) mein aur c m/s mein hai.
Electromagnetic spectrum mein radio waves, microwaves, infrared radiation, nazar aane wali roshni, ultraviolet radiation, X-rays aur gamma rays shamil hain.

blocks.alt: Aik ufuqi patti jo gamma ray, X-ray, ultra violet, patli visible patti, infrared, microwave aur radio frequency mein bati hai, baen taraf sab se zyada tawanai (highest energy) aur daen taraf sab se kam. Oopar wavelength ka paimana 10^-2 se 10^12 nm, daen taraf barhta; neeche frequency ka paimana 10^20 se 10^4 s^-1, baen taraf barhta. Visible patti neeche phaila kar 400 nm (banafshi) se 750 nm (surkh) tak rangeen patti ki shakal mein dikhai gayi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 29.1: Electromagnetic spectrum, wavelength, frequency, tawanai (energy) aur nazar aane wala hissa (kitab ki Figure 29.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Planck ke quantum nazariye ke mutabiq atoms aur molecules sirf muqarrara miqdar (quanta) mein tawanai chhorte ya jazb karte hain, aur radiation ki tawanai us ki frequency ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai: E = h nu = hc / lambda, jahan h Planck's constant, 6.626 x 10^-34 J s, hai. Spectroscopy mein wavenumber, 1/lambda, bhi use hota hai, aam taur par cm^-1 mein, jo tawanai ke mutanasib hai.

blocks.prompt: Fi photon kis ki tawanai zyada hai, ultraviolet ya infrared? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Ultraviolet: is ki wavelength chhoti aur frequency zyada hai, aur E = h nu = hc/lambda.

items: c = lambda x nu; E = h nu = hc/lambda.
Chhoti wavelength yani zyada frequency aur tawanai.
